claims.claim: SessionLoop hands accepted payloads to the application in mailbox sequence
claims.evidence: tests/session/test_session_runner.py::test_the_loop_hands_each_payload_over_in_mailbox_sequence

claims.claim: _render_band touches no shared state; the caller stores the result under the lock
claims.evidence: sgconfig/rules/no-raster-under-panel-lock.yml (poe invariants, in all) + tests/features/tooltip/test_windowed_prefetch.py::test_the_panel_lock_is_not_held_across_a_raster

claims.claim: guard_main_render covers every raster primitive; the main path is structurally warm-only
claims.evidence: raises in _render_band, _scaled_band and _raster_scaled_band; tests/test_render_cache.py::test_the_raster_oracle_can_fire is the control
claims.settles: nothing asserts a NEW raster primitive consults the guard — an enumeration test over the raster leaves

claims.claim: _on_render_loop is correct for the free-threaded thread pool AND the GIL build's ProcessPoolExecutor
claims.evidence: predicate is correct; the pool half guards nothing — the pool submits render_body_band, which never consults it, and _GUARD_MAIN_RENDER is a parent-process global a spawned child re-imports as False
claims.settles: assert _on_render_loop() is False inside a real pool subprocess, or delete the subprocess clause

claims.claim: viewport_warm and missed_last_assemble answer the same question
claims.evidence: was falsified (two enumeration rules); fixed in a2b8f1c4, tests/test_warm_compose.py::test_the_warmth_predicate_agrees_with_the_frame_it_gates with a demonstrated negative control

claims.claim: viewport_bgra(warm_only=True) never rasters, on either branch
claims.evidence: tests/test_render_cache.py::test_a_cold_nested_scroll_still_rasters_nothing_on_the_interactive_thread

claims.claim: last_frame_rasters counts bands rasterised synchronously in the most recent call
claims.evidence: true, but only because the n0->delta window sits inside one RLock hold; _warm_row (a worker) bumps the same counter, and the stated reason at banded.py:331 is false
claims.settles: return the frame's numbers from the compose call instead of reading a panel-wide field, or name the counter for what it counts

claims.claim: assert_no_interactive_raster counts rasters synchronously ON THE CALLING THREAD
claims.evidence: single-thread-correct only — the counter is panel-wide; the oracle proves nobody rastered, not that this thread did not

claims.claim: a duplicate raster from two threads racing one band is benign — last store wins
claims.evidence: survives on pixels (CachedBlock frozen, _store/_add_geom dedup under the lock); falsified on meters — each duplicate bumps _sync_rasters, block_cache_misses and block_rendered_px
claims.settles: a concurrency test racing two warm_viewport calls on one panel; the lane is capacity=1, so it may never occur in production

claims.claim: a concurrent measure of one row costs a duplicate layout, never a wrong offset
claims.evidence: survives — window.py:139 set_height is a pure assignment + memo drop, and warm_measure_to re-checks known(i) under the lock
claims.settles: assert set_height idempotence in render/window.py's own tests, then cite it here

claims.claim: below _assemble_warm_bgra's snapshot everything is immutable — pixels and BGRA memos are replaced, never written through
claims.evidence: survives an attack: to_bgra_array ends in np.ascontiguousarray so memos never alias, and the one in-place mutator receives a fresh array or a .copy()
claims.settles: an ast-grep rule forbidding in-place writes into self._bgra / self._scaled_bgra values

claims.claim: "Call under self._lock" (a precondition) is used distinctly from "Under self._lock" (acquires it)
claims.evidence: no live precondition violation. Two annotations ARE misclassified: precompose says "Under" while acquiring, and _raster_scaled_band says "lock-free half" while acquiring the lock
claims.settles: one phrasing per meaning, then an ast-grep rule on the precondition form

claims.claim: a cold band rasters in ~9ms at real width (measured ~0.034ms/px), under the 16ms budget
claims.evidence: unsupported — no band timing in BENCHMARKS.md, and the cited vibe/ plan is git-ignored scratch that no longer exists. Same for the four newer docstring numbers
claims.settles: a dated BENCHMARKS.md entry with the harness invocation, or delete the numbers
